title: ASIS operative lent to MI6 to bug Kuwaiti government

tellings.quote: And so, the Brits secretly borrowed one of the technical operators buggers from Australia to win a commercial advantage against Australia by bugging the Kuwaiti government offices on behalf of British intelligence.

plain: An Australian journalist, Ross Coulthart, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a spying story from around 1991 that he reported in 1994. He says Britain's foreign spy service, MI6, secretly borrowed a technical bugging expert from Australia's foreign spy service, ASIS, to plant listening devices in Kuwaiti government offices. According to Coulthart, the British used this to win a business advantage over Australia itself, which shows how allied spy agencies can work against each other.
